{header}

{message}
    {options}
""" def create_forum_post(title: str, body: str, topics: list[str]) -> str: """ Construct a sanitized forum post from user-provided content. Returns ------- str A sanitized and formatted forum post string suitable for HTML rendering. Notes ----- * All user input is escaped using html.escape to prevent XSS (CWE‑79). * Markdown formatting inside topics is preserved only as plain text; no rendering of markdown to HTML is performed. """ # Sanitize title and body safe_title = html.escape(title, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(body, quote=True) # Build the list of options escaped_topics = [html.escape(t.strip(), quote=True) for t in topics] options_html = "\n".join(f"
  • {t}
    • " for t in escaped_topics) # Assemble the final post return FORUM_POST_FORMAT.format( header=safe_title, message=safe_body, options=options_html )
